Turning Data Into Value

The point of Big Data is what it lets you DO: uncover hidden patterns and turn them into fast, smart decisions. In this practice you'll make those decisions yourself, then see them play out across industries.

Practice 1 · You decide

The case of the missing snack sales

The case: You're a data analyst at a 2,000-store supermarket chain. At one branch, snack sales are far below forecast. What's your first move?
Next: The data shows snacks sell fine in every other branch — it's this store only. What now?
